source.title: Vacuum balloon — a 350-year-old dream
source.authors: A. Akhmeteli and A. V. Gavrilin
source.locator: Eq9 pp7–8; Fig4 p9; Fig5 and material components p10

quantity: ONE benchmark: Eq9 analytical reproduction, plus separate ideal elastic Fig5 eigenvalue lambda. Neither is a nonlinear collapse or float test.
radius_basis: Outer radius 2.5m, dimensional scale used in paper example; ratios govern elastic ideal comparison.

core_engineering_constants.axes: 1 radial through thickness, 2 meridian tangent, 3 circumferential

material_orientation: CalculiX cylindrical orientation about global z: local1 radial in x-y meridian, local2 meridian tangent, local3 globalz. Exact radial field in defining plane; CalculiX CAX8R internally expands a fixed 2-degree wedge. Its out-of-plane director approximation remains a disclosed method difference from ANSYS spherical coordinates.
core_reciprocity: The three listed independent Poisson ratios are 1e-5; reciprocal ratios follow nu_ji/E_j=nu_ij/E_i. No claim that all six reciprocal components equal 1e-5.
rounded_input_treatment: Use printed Fig5 ratios literally; do not refit h1 to enforce Eq8. Thin-shell mass relation implies q=0.0976744186 for rounded geometry versus nominal0.1. Eq9 analytic optimum separately uses exact q=0.1 and density relations. No parameter tuning after solving.
boundary_reconstruction: Fig4 quadrant in x-y plane, revolution about y. x=0 pole edges ux=0, y=0 equator edges uy=0; all other in-plane DOFs free. Three bonded layers share nodes. Outer face receives inward distributed pressure; inner face free. This reconstructs axisymmetric hemisphere symmetry, without an unpublished clamp.
boundary_limitation: Axisymmetric/equator-symmetric modes only, matching Fig4 modelling class; no independent claim about all possible 3D/asymmetric instabilities.
element: Gmsh quadratic eight-node mapped annular quads; CalculiX CAX8R axisymmetric solids
mesh_convergence_rule: Three frozen meshes, both adjacent abs(lambda_new-lambda_old)/abs(lambda_new)<=0.01; lowest positive eigenvalue, retain all extracted modes.
comparison: Eq9 analytic reproduction plus abs(lambda_fine-2.65)/2.65<=0.05 and declared mesh convergence. A component cannot create another benchmark or point.
